title: Signature Study — Stereo microscope concept (100x 10x)
description: This is a Signature-authored optical design study for a stereo microscope at 100x 10x. Design goals address the real aberration profile: Axial chromatic aberration: colors focus at different depths in the specimen. Spherical aberration: grows with numerical aperture; tamed with aspheric elements. Corrected with a field flattener. Intended application: cell biology.
